note: CORRECTED box, superseding 1shv_tazobactam.json's original Ser70-OG-centered box. Centered on the real crystallographic tazobactam position: fetched 1VM1 (SHV-1's own real tazobactam co-crystal structure -- 1SHV itself is apo, so no ligand position was available from the receptor's own deposition), superimposed onto 1SHV via Bio.PDB Superimposer on 265 matched chain-A CA atoms (0.551 A RMSD -- a tight, high-confidence alignment), then applied the identical transform to TAZ's real coordinates and took their centroid. The original box (Ser70 OG-centered, per the SHV-1-established convention every other Stage 2 target also used) turned out to be ~13 A from this corrected center once an actual crystal-ligand-position check was finally done for this target -- see DECISIONS_AND_LIMITATIONS.md 'SHV-1 box correction' for the full account of how this was found and fixed.
